verdict: Yes, if you are a qualified physiotherapist; this isn't a business you can start without a BPT or MPT degree. It needs little capital, demand from post-surgery, elderly and injury patients is steady, and good therapists get referrals quickly. The limit is travel time, so income grows through packages, clustered appointments and eventually a small team.
angle: Families increasingly prefer rehab at home after surgery or a stroke, especially for elderly patients. Apps have made home physiotherapy common but take a large cut of each visit. Independent therapists who build their own network of orthopaedic surgeons, hospitals and elder-care providers keep more of the fee and get patients who complete their treatment.

faq.q: Can I start a home physiotherapy service without a degree?
faq.a: No. You need a recognised BPT or MPT qualification, and registration with your state council where it is in place. Unqualified treatment can harm patients and has legal consequences.

faq.q: How much does home physiotherapy cost patients?
faq.a: Home sessions typically cost ₹500–1,500 in Indian cities, depending on the city, the condition and the therapist's experience.

faq.q: How much does it cost to start?
faq.a: Portable equipment, insurance and basic branding cost ₹50,000–1.5 lakh. A clinic costs ₹10–25 lakh.

faq.q: How do home physiotherapists find patients?
faq.a: Mostly through referrals from orthopaedic surgeons, hospital discharge teams, elder-care services and satisfied patients, plus a well-reviewed Google Business profile.
